subject: Coffee @RSNA [YEAR]
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw your team with be at RSNA in two weeks so I wanted to reach out for a coffee. We work with Flatiron Health, Viz.ai and Highmark Health to improve DICOM/NIfTI annotation quality - would love to connect at the conference.

Radiology AI teams often struggle to coordinate multi-reader annotation and QC across ML engineers and clinical experts. subject: Move beyond CVAT
text:

Many teams that are using CVAT are struggling by not having a fully
integrated annotation platform. In between data ingestion, curation,
annotation, and evaluation there is scripts to stitch everything together.

use Encord to consolidate this experience.

think.

text:
